posts.title: CHIEF VINCENT NEMIEBOKA MEETS AMANYANABO AND COUNCIL OF BOLO SE OVER UPCOMING DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS
posts.body:
The Executive Chairman of Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area, Chief Vincent Nemieboka DSSRS JP, today met with the Amanyanabo and Council of Bolo Se to brief them on the commencement of several development projects in Bolo Town.
‎
‎The meeting was convened on behalf of Alabo Boma Iyaye DSSRS, Executive Director, Finance and Administration (EDFA), Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC), as part of ongoing efforts to facilitate development and improve infrastructure in the community.
‎

‎During the meeting, the Chairman informed the traditional institution of the planned commencement of the following projects:
‎
‎1. Renovation of Bolo Health Centre: The Rivers State Primary Health Care Board will undertake the renovation of the health facility to improve healthcare delivery in the community.
‎
‎2. Renovation of Bolo-Kira Link Road: The Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) will undertake the renovation of sections of the Bolo-Kira link road, which spans over two kilometres, to improve connectivity and ease the movement of people and goods. Inspection and evaluation has already started. 
‎
‎3. The Ogu/Bolo Local Government Council will commence the renovation of the Amanyanabo’s Palace. The building within the palace of the Amanyanabo of Bolo will be renovated to improve the condition of the traditional institution’s facilities.
‎[photo 2]
‎4. Construction of Internal Roads: The Ogu/Bolo Local Government Council will commence the construction of selected internal roads in Bolo Town to enhance accessibility within the community.
‎
‎In his remarks, the Amanyanabo of Bolo Kingdom, HRH Micha Acheseinimie Frank JP KSC, Bolo Luka VIII, expressed gratitude to Alabo Boma Iyaye and Chief Vincent Nemieboka for their interventions and commitment to the development of Bolo Kingdom.
‎
‎He particularly appreciated their efforts towards improving road infrastructure, facilitating the smooth movement of people and goods, and promoting the overall development of the community.
‎
‎The meeting reaffirmed the importance of collaboration between government institutions, development agencies and traditional leadership in advancing infrastructure development and improving the welfare of the people of Bolo.
‎
‎Media and Communications Unit
‎Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area

The Executive Chairman of Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area, Chief Vincent Nemieboka, DSSRS, joined other invited guests and dignitaries to celebrate the special thanksgiving service of the family of Chief ECJ Amamina Afisoka at St. Gabriel’s Anglican Church, Bolo.

The thanksgiving service was an opportunity for the family to express gratitude to God for His faithfulness, blessings, and protection.

Other dignitaries in attendance included Alabo Boma Iyaye, Leader of the Rainbow Coalition in Ogu/Bolo LGA; Rt. Hon. Evans Bipi; Sir Victor Alabo; and chiefs from the Ogu/Bolo Se Ala Ogbo, among other distinguished guests.

The event was marked by prayers, thanksgiving, and fellowship as the family celebrated God’s goodness.

posts.title: Fifika Chiri Foundation Holds Two-Day Free Medical Outreach for Elderly Persons in Bolo Community
posts.body:
Ogu/Bolo LGA, Rivers State: The Fifika Chiri Foundation will hold its Annual Medical Outreach for elderly residents of Bolo Community on Thursday 12th and Friday 13th November 2026. The outreach is free and open to everyone aged 70 and above.

It will run daily from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. at the Bolo Civic Hall, Bolo Town, Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area.
Free Tests, Consultation and Medication
Beneficiaries will receive free medical services, including:

Eye test
Malaria test
Blood sugar test
HIV screening
Tuberculosis (TB) test (GeneXpert)
Urinalysis
Hepatitis screening
General medical check-up
Medical consultation
Provision of drugs and medications.

A Son of the Soil Giving Back
The Foundation is led by its President and Founder, Alabo (Hon.) Boma Iyaye, DSSRS, (Esq), a proud son of Ogu/Bolo Local Government Area and the Executive Director, Finance and Administration, of the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC).
Through the Foundation, Alabo Iyaye has made the welfare of the elderly in his community a yearly commitment. The outreach is an example of public service that begins at home, bringing healthcare to the doorsteps of those who built the community and often find it hardest to reach a hospital.

An Invitation to the Elderly
The Foundation warmly invites all elderly residents aged 70 and above to attend. Families, neighbours and community leaders are urged to help the elderly get to the Civic Hall on both days.
Your health matters. Come, get checked and stay healthy.
Fifika Chiri Foundation: Serving humanity with compassion.
posts.summary:
The Fifika Chiri Foundation, led by Alabo (Hon.) Boma Iyaye, DSSRS, (Esq), a proud son of Ogu/Bolo LGA and EDFA, NDDC, will hold its Annual Medical Outreach for residents aged 70 and above on Thursday 12th and Friday 13th November 2026, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. daily, at Bolo Civic Hall, Bolo Town.

Beneficiaries will receive free tests, check-ups, consultation and medications.
